verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs describe agents defined via YAML config that run persistently, retain conversation history across crashes/restarts/disconnects, can be triggered via webhooks, and can spawn subagents — all pointing to autonomous background operation with human-in-the-loop approvals for certain actions. However, there's no explicit scheduling/cron-trigger mechanism documented and no independent/hands-on confirmation that agents genuinely run unattended for extended periods without oversight; community discussion focuses mainly on remote control UI/UX rather than confirming autonomous background execution. Missing for 10: dedicated scheduling/trigger automation feature, independent verification of long-running unattended agent behavior.
